_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Tribal Aggression#001.src: My tribes worries our own business, stranger.
Tribal Aggression#001.dst: 我的部族只管自己的事，陌生人。
Tribal Aggression#001.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#002.src: Oh, my apologies, I did not realize you are a warrior of the province! We would be grateful of your help.
Tribal Aggression#002.dst: 哦，抱歉，我沒發現你是這個省的戰士！我們會很感激你的幫助。
Tribal Aggression#002.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#003.src: Our sacred owl totem that we worship was stolen by the cunning Eagle Tribe many years ago. Its magical properties used to bring prosperity to our camp.
Tribal Aggression#003.dst: 我們所供奉的神聖貓頭鷹圖騰，多年前被狡猾的鷹族偷走了。它的魔力曾經為我們的營地帶來繁榮。
Tribal Aggression#003.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#004.src: However, the Eagle tribe are not victorious, we possess their mystic eagle totem, but alas, I do not know who was the original thief.
Tribal Aggression#004.dst: 不過鷹族也沒佔到便宜，他們的神祕鷹圖騰在我們手上；只是唉，我也不知道最初動手的到底是誰。
Tribal Aggression#004.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#005.src: We have been at war for years now, despite being neighbors. Without our totem, our rivalry will continue for ages and peace will never again be felt in our hearts.
Tribal Aggression#005.dst: 我們明明是鄰居，卻已經打了好多年。沒有那座圖騰，這場世仇就會沒完沒了，我們心裡永遠不會再有平靜。
Tribal Aggression#005.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#006.src: Retrieve our totem, and the blessing of the Owl spirit will be with you.
Tribal Aggression#006.dst: 把我們的圖騰取回來，貓頭鷹之靈的祝福就會與你同在。
Tribal Aggression#006.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#007.src: Now, enter the Eagle Camp across the river, you may have to search the camp, I'm sure they have hidden our totem!
Tribal Aggression#007.dst: 好，去河對岸的鷹族營地吧。你大概得把營地翻一遍，我確定他們把我們的圖騰藏起來了！
Tribal Aggression#007.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#008.src: Enter the Eagle Camp and talk to Favian
Tribal Aggression#008.dst: 進入鷹族營地並跟 Favian 談話

Tribal Aggression#009.src: Greetings, what brings you to the noble Eagle tribe?
Tribal Aggression#009.dst: 你好，是什麼風把你吹來高貴的鷹族？
Tribal Aggression#009.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#010.src: You seek the Owl totem? The cursed Owl tribe trying to retain their lost dignity again.
Tribal Aggression#010.dst: 你要找貓頭鷹圖騰？那群該死的梟族又想找回他們失去的顏面了。
Tribal Aggression#010.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#011.src: Why should we give you their totem back? They stole our source of enlightenment all those years ago.
Tribal Aggression#011.dst: 我們憑什麼把他們的圖騰還你？當年是他們偷走了我們啟蒙的泉源。
Tribal Aggression#011.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#012.src: Tell you what, if you can retrieve our Eagle Totem, I will allow you to go return the Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#012.dst: 這樣吧，如果你能把我們的鷹圖騰取回來，我就准你把貓頭鷹圖騰帶回去。
Tribal Aggression#012.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#013.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find, I await your return!
Tribal Aggression#013.dst: 我相信他們把圖騰藏起來了，不過你要是找得到，我等你回來！
Tribal Aggression#013.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#014.src: Bring back the Eagle Totem from the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#014.dst: 從梟族營地取回鷹圖騰

Tribal Aggression#015.src: Wonderful! You may now enter the cave to retrieve the blasted Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#015.dst: 太好了！你現在可以進洞窟去取回那該死的貓頭鷹圖騰了。
Tribal Aggression#015.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#016.src: Be careful, there are Eagle guardians in the cave, be prepared traveller.
Tribal Aggression#016.dst: 小心點，洞窟裡有鷹族守衛，做好準備，旅人。
Tribal Aggression#016.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#017.src: Once you get the totem, you may return it to its original tribe.
Tribal Aggression#017.dst: 等你拿到圖騰，就可以把它送回原本的部族。
Tribal Aggression#017.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#018.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt steal back the totems, and live in peace.
Tribal Aggression#018.dst: 但願我們兩個營地從此再也不必踏上對方的土地去搶圖騰，就這樣和平度日。
Tribal Aggression#018.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#019.src: Anyways, hurry up, even the thought of the two totems sharing the same space makes me sick.
Tribal Aggression#019.dst: 總之，快去吧，光是想到那兩座圖騰共處一室我就渾身不舒服。
Tribal Aggression#019.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#020.src: Retrieve the Owl Totem and return it to the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#020.dst: 取回貓頭鷹圖騰並送回梟族營地

Tribal Aggression#021.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and the Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.
Tribal Aggression#021.dst: 這、這是那座圖騰嗎？天啊，貓頭鷹離開我身邊已經好久了。不過我很好奇，鷹圖騰跟貓頭鷹圖騰是不是擁有同樣的神祕力量。
Tribal Aggression#021.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#022.src: To think, such a long war could end so quickly and by the help of a single person.
Tribal Aggression#022.dst: 想不到這麼漫長的一場戰爭，竟然靠一個人的幫忙就這樣結束了。
Tribal Aggression#022.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#023.src: Many thanks to you! I shall keep my promise, please accept this reward, and may the Owl be forever with you.
Tribal Aggression#023.dst: 萬分感謝！我會信守承諾，請收下這份謝禮，願貓頭鷹永遠與你同在。
Tribal Aggression#023.speaker: Caras
